user_saw: A user asking how /queue works got an invalid queue mode error instead of an agent reply.
summary: The fix preserves ordinary chat prose that mentions /queue while retaining validation for explicit directives and native slash commands.
reasoning: The oldest readable parser already consumed the first unrecognized word after an inline /queue, and its caller already passed that word to the invalid-mode validator.
